chunks: His gaze will not return to him until Allah grants him faith, the sweetness of which he will experience.

key_terms.طَعْمَهُ: its taste, meaning its sweetness or experiential reality
key_terms.يُعْقِبَهُ: causes to follow or grants as a consequence

ai.seo_question: How does a hadith describe experiencing the sweetness of faith?
ai.summary: This narration describes a divine bestowal of iman so immediate and powerful that its effect is felt before one's gaze returns. It emphasizes that true faith is not merely conceptual, but something whose sweetness is inwardly experienced.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "His gaze will not return to him until Allah (swt) grants him faith, the sweetness of which he will experience."
